title: Search in 2D Sorted Matrix
statement:
Given an N×M matrix where each row is sorted in non-decreasing order and the first element of each row is greater than the last element of the previous row. Determine if a target T exists in the matrix.

Print `YES` if found, otherwise `NO`.

Treat the 2D matrix as a 1D sorted array of length N×M and use binary search in O(log(N*M)) time.
inputFormat:
Line 1: three integers N, M, and T.
Next N lines: each contains M space-separated integers.

starterCode.python:
n, m, t = map(int, input().split())
matrix = []
for _ in range(n):
    matrix.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
